transcript: Speaker A: वाणी, टीचर को बोला, आई विल गिव एग्जाम। [Vani, I told the teacher, 'I will give exam.'] Speaker B: एग्जाम तुम टेक करते हो, टीचर गिव करता है। 'आई विल टेक माय एग्जाम' बोलना था, वरना पहले ही फेल हो जाओगे। [You 'take' an exam, the teacher 'gives' it. You should have said 'I will take my exam', otherwise you'll fail beforehand.] Speaker A: भाई, इंग्लिश में इतनी कन्फ्यूजन क्यों है? [Brother, why is there so much confusion in English?] Speaker B: कन्फ्यूजन छोड़ो और स्पीकइजी ऐप ट्राई करो। मैं तुम्हारी सारी गलतियां बिना जज किए ठीक करूंगी, वो भी बिल्कुल सस्ते में। कन्फ्यूजन छोड़ो, बोलना शुरू करो। नीचे क्लिक करके स्पीकइजी ऐप तुरंत डाउनलोड करो। [Leave the confusion and try the SpeakEasy App. I will correct all your mistakes without judging you, and that too very cheaply. Leave the confusion, start speaking. Click below to download the SpeakEasy App immediately.] Speaker C: अभी स्पीकइजी ऐप डाउनलोड करें और फर्राटेदार इंग्लिश बोलना शुरू करें। [Download the SpeakEasy App now and start speaking fluent English.]
on_screen_text: Vani Teacher Ko Bola / I Will Give Exam. / Exam Tum Take Karte Ho, / Teacher Give Karta Hai. / I Will Take My Exam / Bolna Tha Varna Pehle Hi / Fail Ho Jaoge. / Bhai English Me Itni / Confusion Kyun Hai? / Confusion Chhodo Aur / SpeakEasy App Try Karo. / Main Tumhari Sari Galtiyan / Bina Judge Kiye / Theek Karoongi. / Vo Bhi Bilkul Saste Me. / Confusion Chhodo, / Bolna Shuru Karo. / Neeche Click Karke / SpeakEasy App / Turant Download Karo / Speakeasy AI / Speak English Easily with SpeakEasy / Install Now / GET IT ON Google Play / Download on the App Store
summary: A man gets corrected by an AI avatar on the proper English phrasing for taking an exam. The AI then pitches the SpeakEasy app as an affordable, non-judgmental way to learn English. The ad concludes with a call to action to download the app.
